# Rule 4 — Roleplay standards
Project Verdant is a roleplay server. You are expected to play a believable character who reacts reasonably to the situation around them.
Stay in character during the round. Your actions should create roleplay and interaction rather than treating the round as a mechanics-only playground.
Your character should have a reasonable name, personality, and motivation. Low-effort characters or characters made only to disrupt others may be removed.
Roleplay does not require you to be serious all the time, but your actions should still make sense for your character, your job, and the current round situation.
